facts.statement: Panxiosteus is an extinct genus of placoderm fish belonging to the arthrodire group.
facts.quote: Panxiosteus is an extinct monospecific genus of placoderm arthrodire from the Middle Devonian: Givetian stage of Yunnan province, China.

facts.statement: The genus Panxiosteus was described by Wang in 1979.
Fossils of Panxiosteus date to the Givetian stage of the Middle Devonian.
Panxiosteus lived approximately 383.4 to 382.31 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Givetian to Givetian (383.4 to 382.31 million years ago)

facts.statement: The type species of the genus Panxiosteus is Panxiosteus oculus.
Panxiosteus is classified as a member of the family Panxiosteidae.
facts.quote: Panxiosteus is a member of Panxiosteidae.

facts.statement: A 2010 study placed Panxiosteidae as the sister taxon to Dunkleosteidae within the superfamily Dunkleosteoidea.
facts.quote: In the 2010 Carr & Hlavin phylogenetic study, Panxiosteidae was recognized as the sister taxon to the family Dunkleosteidae, which together comprised the superfamily Dunkleosteoidea

facts.statement: A 2016 study using a larger dataset recovered Panxiosteidae outside of Dunkleosteoidea, instead placing it within Coccosteoidea as the sister group of Coccosteidae.
facts.quote: However, the subsequent 2016 Zhu et al. study using a larger morphological dataset recovered Panxiosteidae well outside of Dunkleosteoidea, instead within Coccosteomorphi and then Coccosteoidea as the sister group of Coccosteidae

facts.statement: Only one fossil occurrence of Panxiosteus has been recorded in the Paleobiology Database.
